scope: synthetic outcome-blind context-count precision sensitivity analysis

planning_decision.next_action: If no candidate passes, do not create a context manifest. Revise the study scope, acquire additional independent contexts, or explicitly downgrade the planned claim before proceeding.

interpretation.primary: The original 15-context confirmation target is too fragile across the frozen central scenarios. The selected count is a planning increase, not evidence that either detector family performs well.
interpretation.stress: No candidate is expected to make every low-density, extreme-prevalence, high-ICC stress scenario precise. Those scenarios remain explicit claim limits.
interpretation.cluster_limit: The selected design remains below 30 independent confirmation contexts, so cluster-bootstrap intervals require caution and subgroup results remain descriptive.
interpretation.metric_limit: All reported values are simulated interval half-width summaries. They are not observed AUPRC, F1, prevalence, or detector-comparison results.
